- **3** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/services/service-print/README.md`, `packages/services/service-print/package.json`, `packages/services/service-print/vitest.config.ts`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run

- **8** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **4** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 7d6ec91d2f89e834fc5b82183a95cb3c5427a882` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `418ad3608969d7670826dadd8e2155d172af2358` — the merge of head `8e8cfc60af7cf52b7b535b4e6ccafd1e37e84597` into base `7d6ec91d2f89e834fc5b82183a95cb3c5427a882`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 418ad3608969d7670826dadd8e2155d172af2358 && git checkout 418ad3608969d7670826dadd8e2155d172af2358
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 7d6ec91d2f89e834fc5b82183a95cb3c5427a882 8e8cfc60af7cf52b7b535b4e6ccafd1e37e84597 && git checkout -B drift-repro 7d6ec91d2f89e834fc5b82183a95cb3c5427a882 && git merge --no-ff 8e8cfc60af7cf52b7b535b4e6ccafd1e37e84597

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 7d6ec91d2f89e834fc5b82183a95cb3c5427a882
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 7d6ec91d2f89e834fc5b82183a95cb3c5427a882` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 席位核对

ACCEPT · `domain:services` seat 1 (#6021) · `marchtian` · `session_01Nk17Z26X5DB59iQztDBADH` · 2026-10-17T17:47Z · head `8e8cfc60af`. It covers round 0 (`021f86051`, read by the seat at `6236835345` on #22270) and patch round 1. It lands through the merge queue once every check on this head is green.

- **Shape:** a draft PR to `main`. Its first line is `Fixes #22270`, and that is the only closing keyword in the body (the seat's ruling at `6236835345`). `Clause-②: no` is at a line start in the body and in the changeset. Card and PR assignee: `marchtian`. Not governed: `check-governed-merges` reads 0 of 21 paths, and 1322 changed lines ≤ 3000.
- **Contract review (#8346's ruling: "Each card carries its refusal cases and the contract review"):** the diff touches none of the four contract faces. There is no `Clause-②: yes` declaration and no narrowing declaration, nothing under `packages/spec/src`, and no governed text. The review is therefore CI plus this seat's read. `Clause-②: no` was measured by the dev on the built `dist/index.d.ts`: the same 14 exported names as the base (`src/index.ts` is byte-identical), with one `private mountDoor;` member added to the class. There is no new plugin option, schema or error code.
- **The door, read by the seat (`print-routes.ts`):** `POST /api/v1/print/records`, mounted at `kernel:ready` on the kernel's `http-server`. With no HTTP server it logs one `warn` and mounts nothing. Its order:
  1. the caller, through `resolveAuthzContext`. An authorization-store outage or an API-key lifecycle refusal is relayed with its own `code` and `status`.
  2. anonymous → `UNAUTHENTICATED` / 401;
  3. a held sign-in → `403` with the gate's code;
  4. an impersonation session (`session.impersonatedBy` on the session read that admitted the caller; session credentials only) → `PERMISSION_DENIED` / 403;
  5. any query parameter, or a body field outside `{ app, object, recordId, page, filename }` → `VALIDATION_ERROR` / 400;
  6. then `printRecordToFile(request, context)` → `201` with `{ fileId, attachmentId, size, filename }`.
- **The card's refusal cases, relayed with the service's own `code` and `status`:** no render driver → `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` / 503, with the door's own sentence and the reason in the fault log; a page without `print` → `VALIDATION_ERROR` / 400; a caller without read access → `RECORD_NOT_FOUND` / 404. These are pinned in `print-routes.test.ts`, and the no-engine 503 again on a real boot by the dogfood pin.
- **Patch round 1, read by the seat:**
  - `TRANSPORT_LEDGER` gains `'packages/services/service-print/src/print-routes.ts': 'guarded'`, classified honestly: the caller-resolution `catch` relays `isAuthzStoreUnavailableError` with its status. RED without the row (10 transports against 9 rows), GREEN with it.
  - `print-door-impersonation.dogfood.test.ts` boots the real showcase with the admin plugin on (`OS_SCIM_ENABLED`). The admin's own session reaches the service (503), and the impersonation session the admin starts through `/auth/admin/impersonate-user` is refused at the door (403, the message naming impersonation). Ablated through `dist`: with the guard disabled, the pin answered `[SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE, 503]`. Restored: blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty, and the marker is absent from `dist/`.
  - PR #24185 adds its own row to the same object. `git merge-tree` of the two heads is clean, and the merged ledger carries both rows.
- **Prose faces, each sentence checked against the diff:**
  - **The changeset's bullets** match the door: the route, the body, the `201` shape, the refusal order and codes, "the route never attaches anything itself", the no-HTTP-server `warn`, and the stated limit on impersonation detection.
  - **Its 5xx sentence**, "A 5xx answers with the route's own sentence", is exact for every refusal `print-service.ts` throws, because `printRefusal` sets no `refusal: true`. The one exception, a 5xx whose producer declares `refusal: true`, is stated in the module header. Accepted as written.
  - **`content/docs/ui/print-pages.mdx` "Print from the console"** matches the same facts, and its `defineAction` example matches the showcase action's shape.
  - **The `service-print` README's three lines** match too.
- **Gates on this head:** 37 checks succeeded and 5 were skipped by design (Console Pin Gate, Dogfood Regression Gate, Dogfood Verify CLI, Packed-tarball smoke, Temporal Conformance: the roster set). There were no failures. Locally: 130 derived families, 130 exit 0.

  - `origin/main` is 3 commits past the merge base, and the merge group re-runs the gates.
- **Out-of-scope findings:**
  - filed objectstack-ai/objectui#12906 (p1): the record-header actions on print pages;
  - filed #24196: `AuthSessionApi` declared fields;
  - Acceptance notes: the "printing is off" `warn`, and the stale "Five route ledgers" header in the parity gate.
